name: attention
description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin whose Claude lifecycle-hook sensors feed allowlisted runtime-owned executors (ADR-0040 §3, amended by ADR-0044 §2): notify.mjs emit for operator notifications and context.mjs publish-session for session capture (Stop-ordered before notification work, dual capability floors, declaration in data/runtime-floors.json). Hooks + sensor scripts only: no skills, no verbs, no state machinery. The plugin contributes zero plugin-owned Codex hook surface: the Codex manifest declares no hooks AND the Claude registration is manifest-scoped at adapters/claude/hooks/hooks.json, deliberately outside Codex's default-file discovery (host truth: Codex 0.144.1 loads a root hooks/hooks.json regardless of command shape — ADR-0040 §3 amendment). Codex-side attention comes from the runtime's native host-config M1 fragment plans (runtime:settings --notification-plan) per ADR-0040 §4; the ADR-0044 capture firing point is Claude-only at v1 (§8).

interface.shortDescription: Claude lifecycle hook sensors that feed the runtime's notification emitter and session-capture publisher (approval / idle / terminal notifications + turn-end capture)
interface.longDescription: Hook-only Layer 1 plugin per ADR-0040 §3, amended by ADR-0044 §2 into host-lifecycle sensors feeding allowlisted runtime-owned executors — the hook-bearing sibling of the ADR-0008 script-only library shape. On Claude Code it registers Notification (permission_prompt → approval with urgent urgency, idle_prompt → idle), Stop (three stages: shared evidence collection, then the session-capture spawn — context.mjs publish-session with fixed argv, ordered before any notification-only construction or short-circuit, in its own failure boundary — then workflow-terminal when a freshness-checked last-session-handoff.json projection proves a terminal persona workflow per ADR-0043 §3, else bare turn-complete from documented common input fields), and SubagentStop (subagent-complete). Each sensor resolves the runtime plugin root through a copied discover-runtime ladder (env override → Claude cache SemVer-max → Codex fixed cache → sibling monorepo) with dual capability floors that never share a constant: notify >= 0.71.0 (the first release shipping notify.mjs) and publish-session >= 0.82.0 (the first release shipping the publisher, declared byte-for-byte in data/runtime-floors.json per session-capture-contract §13). Below the publisher floor — or when the floor passes but the executor file is absent (capability drift) — capture skips silently while notifications keep working. Sensors are fail-closed silent observers: exit 0 always, never stdout, no Stop decision output; notification short-circuits never skip capture and capture failure never skips notification; a missing or too-old runtime is a silent no-op. Notifications stay off until the operator opts into a channel (notify_channel default none) and capture stays off until session_capture is opted in (default off, evaluated publisher-side), both via runtime:settings. The plugin exposes no plugin-owned hook surface to Codex: this manifest declares no hooks and no functional skills (the skills/ directory is the Codex manifest-spec placeholder per the ADR-0008 carve-out), and the Claude registration lives at the manifest-scoped adapters/claude/hooks/hooks.json — deliberately outside Codex's default-file discovery, which host truth (Codex 0.144.1) showed loads a root hooks/hooks.json regardless of command shape (ADR-0040 §3 amendment). Codex-side attention is planned through runtime:settings --notification-plan M1 fragments (ADR-0040 §4); the ADR-0044 capture firing point is Claude-only at v1 (§8).
